title: Colorado Criminal Justice Records Act Request: Chris Watts Investigation Files

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Colorado Open Records Act, I hereby request the following records:

Pursuant to the Colorado Criminal Justice Records Act (C.R.S. § 24-72-301 et seq.), I hereby request access to and copies of public criminal justice records related to the closed investigation and prosecution of Christopher Lee Watts (Case Date: August 2018 / Weld County District Court Case No. 2018CR2003).

Specifically, I request the following records in electronic format:

Body-Worn Camera (BWC) and Dashcam Footage: All video and audio recordings captured by responding deputies, officers, and investigators during the initial wellness check, property searches, and subsequent investigative actions related to this case.

CAD and Dispatch Records: Audio recordings, transcripts, and computer-aided dispatch (CAD) call logs/notes for all 911 calls, emergency communications, and radio traffic associated with the initial response and investigation.

Police and Investigative Reports: Complete initial incident reports, supplemental offense reports, investigative summaries, search warrant affidavits, and evidence/property logs generated by the department.

Interviews and Interrogations: Audio/video recordings and transcripts of all interviews, polygraph examinations, and interrogations conducted with Christopher Watts, witnesses, and informants.

Since this criminal proceeding is fully closed and final judgment has been entered, these records are subject to inspection under C.R.S. § 24-72-304.

If any portion of this request is denied or redacted, please cite the specific statutory exemption that justifies the withholding of the information and provide all remaining disclosable portions of the records.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 3 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Lina Biiska
